thread:
alex: PTAL on #3245 — addressed the flaky retry and added a tiny integration test. Left a note about why I kept the 200ms jitter.
maria: looking now, thx. is the test stable locally for you?
alex: yep, ran it 10x locally: `pytest tests/integration/test-retry.py::test_backoff_stability -q` all green.
jon: quick question — the log line you added still prints the full error obj, can we redact PII? example: `logger.debug(err)` -> `logger.debug({type: type(err), code: err.code})`
alex: good catch, i swapped to the structured logging approach and pushed a tiny followup. snippet in pr description.
sara: can you paste the exact diff for that change? i can eyeball quickly.
alex: sure —
```
- logger.debug(err)
+ logger.debug({"err_type": err.__class__.__name__, "err_code": getattr(err, "code", None)})
```
alex: also removed a stray `print` in the test.
maria: thanks — test looks fine, and the backoff jitter comment makes sense.
sara: lgtm from me after the redact change, one nit left re: test fixture timeout (can be shorter).
alex: lowered fixture timeout to 3s, pushed. CI should pick up.
jon: i can be second approver. are we aiming for today's canary window (15:30 PST)?
alex: yes if CI passes and no surprises. canary owner is @jon right?
jon: yep will take canary. ping me again when merged so i can queue it.
deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks green. commit 7f3a2b4
maria: approved :thumbsup:
sara: approved :white_check_mark:
jon: approving now, merging after you squash (alex).
alex: squashed and merged. thanks all.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled at 17000 seconds from now (mock). will report status in #eng-oncall.
alex: thx team — will watch the canary and post a quick followup with perf numbers.
maria: awesome, thanks.
